_about: Public-domain Charles Comfort Tiffany (1829-1907), Episcopal rector and archdeacon of New York, for the Word Hoard: A History of the Protestant Episcopal Church in the United States of America, and The Prayer Book and the Christian Life. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 115 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
